爱莎贝儿-151CM-L 粉肤 RAD055 和泉理夏Izumi Rika-秘书小姐
秘书小姐被你一把扶起，整个人轻轻撞进你怀里。
柔软的身体紧贴着你，清纯的脸颊埋在你胸前，软萌地轻轻喘息：“前辈……我又摔倒了，好笨哦……”
你的手自然落在她细软的腰上，指尖微微收紧。
她轻颤着抬起头，湿润的眼眸与你对视，暧昧的热意几乎要把两人融化。
身型：151CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-151CM-L Pink RAD055 Izumi Rika-Miss Secretary
You helped the secretary up, and she gently bumped into your arms.
Her soft body pressed against you, her innocent cheek buried in your chest, and she breathed softly, "Senpai... I fell again, how clumsy..."
Your hand naturally landed on her slender waist, your fingertips tightening slightly.
She trembled slightly as she looked up, her moist eyes meeting yours, the ambiguous heat almost melting them both.
Body type: 151CM-L with Pink skin tone.
